# 生成对抗网络及其主要变体

生成对抗网络（generative adversarial network, GAN）由 Goodfellow 等提出[1]。其框架包含生成器 G 与判别器 D：G 将隐变量映射为样本，D 判断输入来自真实数据还是 G。二者交替优化极小极大目标；理论上，当 D 无法区分两者时，G 已拟合数据分布，训练达到纳什均衡。但原始目标在最优 D 下等价于最小化 JS 散度；当真实分布与生成分布的支撑几乎不交叠时，梯度消失，训练不稳定并易发生模式崩溃。

在损失函数层面，Arjovsky 等以 Earth Mover（Wasserstein）距离替代 JS 散度，提出 WGAN，并通过权重裁剪施加 Lipschitz 约束，使判别器损失与生成质量相关[4]。WGAN-GP 用梯度惩罚取代裁剪，缓解了容量受限与调参困难的问题[5]；谱归一化则约束判别器各层的谱范数，以较低开销稳定训练[6]。

在结构与条件控制方面，条件 GAN 将类别或其他辅助信息拼接到 G、D 的输入，实现可控生成[2]；DCGAN 系统引入全卷积结构、批归一化与 ReLU/LeakyReLU，奠定了图像 GAN 的基本架构[3]。pix2pix 把条件 GAN 用于成对图像翻译[7]，CycleGAN 则以循环一致性损失实现无配对图像域转换[8]。

高质量生成的代表是渐进式 GAN 与 StyleGAN。前者从低分辨率开始，逐层增长生成器与判别器，先学习整体布局，再补充细节[9]；后者用映射网络把隐码变换到中间隐空间，并通过自适应实例归一化将风格注入各分辨率层，显著提升解耦性与可控性[10]。

GAN 已广泛用于图像生成与编辑、超分辨率、数据增强等任务，其对抗训练思想也影响了后续生成模型。不过，训练动力学、评价指标以及深度伪造滥用等问题仍有待解决。

## References

[1] Ian Goodfellow, Jean Pouget-Abadie, Mehdi Mirza, Bing Xu, David Warde-Farley, Sherjil Ozair, Aaron Courville, Yoshua Bengio. Generative Adversarial Networks. *Communications of the ACM*, 2020, 63(11): 139–144. DOI: 10.1145/3422622.

[2] Mehdi Mirza, Simon Osindero. Conditional Generative Adversarial Nets. *arXiv preprint* arXiv:1411.1784, 2014. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1411.1784.

[3] Alec Radford, Luke Metz, Soumith Chintala. Unsupervised Representation Learning with Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks. *International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR)*, 2016. arXiv:1511.06434. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1511.06434.

[4] Martin Arjovsky, Soumith Chintala, Léon Bottou. Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks. *Proceedings of the 34th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML)*, PMLR, 2017, 70: 214–223. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1701.07875.

[5] Ishaan Gulrajani, Faruk Ahmed, Martin Arjovsky, Vincent Dumoulin, Aaron Courville. Improved Training of Wasserstein GANs. *Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)*, 2017, 30: 5767–5777. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1704.00028.

[6] Takeru Miyato, Toshiki Kataoka, Masanori Koyama, Yuichi Yoshida. Spectral Normalization for Generative Adversarial Networks. *International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR)*, 2018. arXiv:1802.05957. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1802.05957.

[7] Phillip Isola, Jun-Yan Zhu, Tinghui Zhou, Alexei A. Efros. Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks. *Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)*, 2017: 1125–1134. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2017.632.

[8] Jun-Yan Zhu, Taesung Park, Phillip Isola, Alexei A. Efros. Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation Using Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks. *Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)*, 2017: 2223–2232. DOI: 10.1109/ICCV.2017.244.

[9] Tero Karras, Timo Aila, Samuli Laine, Jaakko Lehtinen. Progressive Growing of GANs for Improved Quality, Stability, and Variation. *International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR)*, 2018. arXiv:1710.10196. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1710.10196.

[10] Tero Karras, Samuli Laine, Timo Aila. A Style-Based Generator Architecture for Generative Adversarial Networks. *Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)*, 2019: 4401–4410. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2019.00453.

# 生成对抗网络及其主要变体

生成对抗网络（generative adversarial network, GAN）由 Goodfellow 等提出[1]。其框架包含生成器 G 与判别器 D：G 将隐变量映射为样本，D 判断输入来自真实数据还是 G。二者交替优化极小极大目标；理论上，当 D 无法区分两者时，G 已拟合数据分布，训练达到纳什均衡。但原始目标在最优 D 下等价于最小化 JS 散度；当真实分布与生成分布的支撑几乎不交叠时，梯度消失，训练不稳定并易发生模式崩溃。

在损失函数层面，Arjovsky 等以 Earth Mover（Wasserstein）距离替代 JS 散度，提出 WGAN，并通过权重裁剪施加 Lipschitz 约束，使判别器损失与生成质量相关[4]。WGAN-GP 用梯度惩罚取代裁剪，缓解了容量受限与调参困难的问题[5]；谱归一化则约束判别器各层的谱范数，以较低开销稳定训练[6]。

在结构与条件控制方面，条件 GAN 将类别或其他辅助信息拼接到 G、D 的输入，实现可控生成[2]；DCGAN 系统引入全卷积结构、批归一化与 ReLU/LeakyReLU，奠定了图像 GAN 的基本架构[3]。pix2pix 把条件 GAN 用于成对图像翻译[7]，CycleGAN 则以循环一致性损失实现无配对图像域转换[8]。

高质量生成的代表是渐进式 GAN 与 StyleGAN。前者从低分辨率开始，逐层增长生成器与判别器，先学习整体布局，再补充细节[9]；后者用映射网络把隐码变换到中间隐空间，并通过自适应实例归一化将风格注入各分辨率层，显著提升解耦性与可控性[10]。

GAN 已广泛用于图像生成与编辑、超分辨率、数据增强等任务，其对抗训练思想也影响了后续生成模型。不过，训练动力学、评价指标以及深度伪造滥用等问题仍有待解决。

## References

[1] Ian Goodfellow, Jean Pouget-Abadie, Mehdi Mirza, Bing Xu, David Warde-Farley, Sherjil Ozair, Aaron Courville, Yoshua Bengio. Generative Adversarial Networks. *Communications of the ACM*, 2020, 63(11): 139–144. DOI: 10.1145/3422622.

[2] Mehdi Mirza, Simon Osindero. Conditional Generative Adversarial Nets. *arXiv preprint* arXiv:1411.1784, 2014. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1411.1784.

[3] Alec Radford, Luke Metz, Soumith Chintala. Unsupervised Representation Learning with Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks. *International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR)*, 2016. arXiv:1511.06434. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1511.06434.

[4] Martin Arjovsky, Soumith Chintala, Léon Bottou. Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks. *Proceedings of the 34th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML)*, PMLR, 2017, 70: 214–223. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1701.07875.

[5] Ishaan Gulrajani, Faruk Ahmed, Martin Arjovsky, Vincent Dumoulin, Aaron Courville. Improved Training of Wasserstein GANs. *Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)*, 2017, 30: 5767–5777. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1704.00028.

[6] Takeru Miyato, Toshiki Kataoka, Masanori Koyama, Yuichi Yoshida. Spectral Normalization for Generative Adversarial Networks. *International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR)*, 2018. arXiv:1802.05957. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1802.05957.

[7] Phillip Isola, Jun-Yan Zhu, Tinghui Zhou, Alexei A. Efros. Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks. *Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)*, 2017: 1125–1134. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2017.632.

[8] Jun-Yan Zhu, Taesung Park, Phillip Isola, Alexei A. Efros. Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation Using Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks. *Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)*, 2017: 2223–2232. DOI: 10.1109/ICCV.2017.244.

[9] Tero Karras, Timo Aila, Samuli Laine, Jaakko Lehtinen. Progressive Growing of GANs for Improved Quality, Stability, and Variation. *International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR)*, 2018. arXiv:1710.10196. DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1710.10196.

[10] Tero Karras, Samuli Laine, Timo Aila. A Style-Based Generator Architecture for Generative Adversarial Networks. *Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)*, 2019: 4401–4410. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2019.00453.

**说明：** ICLR 论文集不分配卷期页码，arXiv 预印本（[2]）亦无卷期，相应条目以 arXiv 编号标注，DOI 采用 arXiv 注册的 DataCite DOI；NeurIPS/ICML 条目无出版社注册 DOI，同样以 arXiv DOI 替代。当前环境无法联网核验，建议投稿前逐条复核 DOI 与页码。
